id_note: Conjugal Round 15 scoring dimensions and seat lenses, verbatim from C:\code\Conjugal\docs\architecture\approach-a\prompts\round15-*-prompt.txt. For any other subject, write a rubric of the same shape; rubric_id is computed from it plus the seat roster and blinding.

dimensions.name: Timeline Realism
dimensions.definition: Stage S + Phase 1 line items; DAG forecasts; 2a/2b/2c; executable gates

dimensions.name: Contract Completeness
dimensions.definition: can Luna code every section without asking a question? Is anything referenced but undefined?

dimensions.name: Cross-Family Safety
dimensions.definition: pair quorum + epochs, artifact-bound votes, event registry fences, single SEAL rule, cross-family A pair, trust anchor, no shared secret, no single-lane authority

dimensions.name: Autonomy Achievement
dimensions.definition: advisory budgets, ROTATE_REQUEST/ROTATION_COMPLETE, bounded WAIT-*/BLOCKED-CAPACITY dispositions, no new owner gates, Tier 0 stopping rule

dimensions.name: Throughput Goal
dimensions.definition: ordered throughput plan, reducer capacity model, G-MEASURE, measured_multiple signed with CI, substrate provably not the bottleneck

dimensions.name: Risk Mitigation
dimensions.definition: every mechanism has a scenario with a pass criterion; clock domains explicit; residuals stated once

lenses.panel-fable: coherence and contract completeness - can an implementer code every section without asking; every term defined once; every event/ref/scenario referenced exists; owner directives honored verbatim.
lenses.panel-opus: orchestration and throughput - reducer capacity model, pipelined publication attribution (depth 1 vs 2 at the same derived P_pub), lease/fence correctness under concurrency, recovery semantics, substrate provably not the bottleneck.
lenses.panel-sonnet1: timeline realism and testability - Stage S and Phase 1 line items, manifest-derived forecasts and the critical path, every scenario has an executable pass criterion, phase gates runnable as written.
lenses.panel-sonnet2: concurrency and recovery adversary - races between floors/sidecars/reducer, crash points (n-commit/n+1-build handoff, relay commit, helper-result ingress), idempotency keys that dedup a valid event or admit a stale one, index.lock and shared-worktree hazards.
lenses.panel-sonnet3: autonomy and owner directives - advisory budgets (budget_mode default unrestricted, nothing stalls), latch episodes with one ROTATE_REQUEST and automatic resume, bounded WAIT-*/BLOCKED-CAPACITY dispositions, no new owner gates, Tier 0 stopping rule and rubric_id pinning.
lenses.panel-astra: Codex design explorer: cross-family routing under latch/rotation, deterministic attestation seat identities, reducer capacity ceiling, Phase 2 arithmetic and resumability, Tier 0 coherence with its evidence.
lenses.panel-sol: Codex orchestration verifier: safety gates, contract completeness, recovery semantics, quorum/attestation soundness, trust anchor and revocation, seal/immutability, no single-lane authority.
lenses.panel-luna: Codex implementer: can you code every section on a shared Windows git checkout without asking a question; are the registry fences, epochs, quota adapter fields, unit table, and reducer supervisor implementable; is the build stage honest.
